tools.name: search_fonts
tools.description: Use this to find fonts for a project: by mood or use ("warm editorial serif", "code", "geometric branding"), category, or licence. uses keeps only fonts whose answer is a plain yes for every use listed, e.g. ["commercial","web","app"]. For "which font loads fastest" pass sort "size" (lightest first

tools.name: get_font
tools.description: Use this for everything about one font: foundry, designers, live version and weights, the CSS URL to load it, facts measured from the font file (cap height, x-height, average width and stem in em, glyph count, scripts, languages, OS/2 embedding bits, WOFF2 bytes per weight, webBytes: what its own CD

tools.name: check_font_license
tools.description: Use this when someone asks "can I use <font> for <use>". Answers yes, no, conditional or unknown, with why, a verbatim quote from the licence, the source URL, a sha256 of the licence text checked and the date checked. Uses: commercial (Use it in commercial work: brand, marketing, products you sell.)

tools.name: pair_fonts
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what font goes with a font ("what pairs with Avenir", "a body font for Montserrat"). Returns the fonts that real websites load with it, counted on a crawl of the home pages of the top sites in one pinned Tranco list: sites loading both, share, lift over chance, example dom

tools.name: best_fonts_for_use
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for the best font for a resume, tattoo, logo, wedding, handwriting ("best font for a resume", "a tattoo script", "a logo font I can trademark", "wedding invitation fonts", "a handwriting font"). Returns our picks with why, then the most used fonts of each style ranked and

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_fonts, get_font, check_font_license, best_fonts_for_use · Private data: get_font, check_font_license, best_fonts_for_use · Public sink: pair_fonts, best_fonts_for_use · Destructive: check_font_license.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_fonts, get_font, check_font_license, best_fonts_for_use · Private data: get_font, check_font_license, best_fonts_for_use · Public sink: pair_fonts, best_fonts_for_use · Destructive: check_font_license

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
